Native offline authenticator export viewer. Your phone remains the source of truth.

Download the package matching your system. Linux AppImages include X11 and Wayland integrations. Windows installers are per-user; portable ZIPs launch from `bin/aeris.exe`. The macOS DMG contains one universal app for Intel and Apple silicon.

Packages have no publisher signing certificate or notarization. The macOS bundle uses the ad-hoc signatures required by Apple silicon. Verify SHA256SUMS and the accompanying GitHub build attestations. SPDX SBOMs and dependency license texts accompany the release.

Every import replaces the entire collection after review. See the README and format matrix for supported exports and limits. Use **Delete all…** before uninstalling to remove Aeris's saved credentials and imported snapshot.
